answer: Fingerprints are counted in mirror, thus the distribution is public, and plume lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. The declaration is a ferrous header, so 2968 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. The deposit is 5 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
